        "contents": "import { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\nimport { z } from 'zod'\n\nconst createServiceSchema = z.object({\n  name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),\n  url: z.url('Invalid URL format'),\n  method: z.enum(['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']).default('GET'),\n  tags: z.array(z.string()).default([]),\n  type: z.enum(['public', 'private']).default('public'),\n})\n\n/**\n * POST /services\n * Add new service (authentication required)\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  await requireUserSession(event)\n\n  const validateBody = await readValidatedBody(event, createServiceSchema.safeParse)\n  if (!validateBody.success) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: validateBody.error.message,\n    })\n  }\n\n  const body = validateBody.data\n\n  // Validate required fields\n  if (!body.name || !body.url) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing required fields: name, url',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Insert new monitor\n  const [newService] = await db.insert(schema.services).values({\n    name: body.name,\n    url: body.url,\n    method: body.method,\n    tags: body.tags,\n    type: body.type,\n  }).returning()\n\n  return {\n    monitor: newService,\n  }\n})",

        "contents": "export default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  const config = useRuntimeConfig()\n\n  // Vercel CRON_SECRET security check\n  if (getHeader(event, 'authorization') !== &#96;Bearer ${config.cronSecret}&#96;) {\n    throw createError({ statusCode: 401 })\n  }\n\n  // Call Nitro task\n  const { result } = await runTask('check')\n  return { success: true, result }\n})",

        "contents": "---\nalwaysApply: true\n---\n# Overview\n\nThis is an uptime monitoring website built with Nuxt 4 and Nuxthub, and styling with unocss.\n\n## NPM package manager\n\nShould be pnpm, but alway install package with &#96;[ni](https://github.com/antfu-collective/ni)&#96; and related command.\n\n## How to use Nuxthub?\n\nNuxthub is a Nuxt module provider a complete backend experience on top of the framework that can deploy on many cloud providers, allowing developers to build full-stack applications.\n\n### Database\n\n- **Database Dialect**: The database dialect is set in the &#96;nuxt.config.ts&#96; file, within the &#96;hub.db&#96; option or &#96;hub.db.dialect&#96; property.\n- **Drizzle Config**: Don't generate the &#96;drizzle.config.ts&#96; file manually, it is generated automatically by NuxtHub.\n- **Generate Migrations**: Use &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to automatically generate database migrations from schema changes\n- **Never Write Manual Migrations**: Do not manually create SQL migration files in the &#96;server/db/migrations/&#96; directory\n- **Workflow**:\n  1. Create or modify the database schema in &#96;server/db/schema.ts&#96; or any other schema file in the &#96;server/db/schema/&#96; directory\n  2. Run &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to generate the migration\n  3. Run &#96;npx nuxt db migrate&#96; to apply the migration to the database, or run &#96;npx nuxt dev&#96; to apply the migration during development\n- **Access the database**: Use the &#96;db&#96; instance from &#96;hub:db&#96; to query the database, it is a Drizzle ORM instance.\n- **Access the database schema**: Use the &#96;schema&#96; from &#96;hub:db&#96; to access the schemas.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",

            "text": "alwaysApply: true",

        "contents": "# NuxtPulse\n\nNuxtPulse is a modern uptime monitoring / status page\n\nNuxtPulse base on Nuxt.js and [@nuxthub/core](https://nuxt.com/modules/hub), learn more on [hub.nuxt.com](https://hub.nuxt.com/).\n\n## Features\n\n&gt; WIP\n\n## Development\n\n### Setup\n\nMake sure to install the dependencies with pnpm.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\npnpm install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThen start development server with &#96;dev&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\npnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deploy\n\n### Vercel\n\nOn the Vercel dashboard -&gt; Storage, create a Turso SQLite database.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\nnpm run deploy-vercel\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nLink the newly created resources to your project and re-deploy.\n\nYou can also connect using your git repository to leverage Vercel's CI/CD pipeline.\n\n### Cloudflare worker\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\nnpm run deploy-cloudflare\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWrangler will create the necessary resources on your Cloudflare account.\n\nYou can also connect using your git repository to leverage Cloudflare's CI/CD pipeline.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# NuxtPulse",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "NuxtPulse is a modern uptime monitoring / status page",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "NuxtPulse base on Nuxt.js and [@nuxthub/core](https://nuxt.com/modules/hub), learn more on [hub.nuxt.com](https://hub.nuxt.com/).",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Features",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; WIP",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## Development",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### Setup",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "Make sure to install the dependencies with pnpm.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sh",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "pnpm install",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "Then start development server with &#96;dev&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sh",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "pnpm dev",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "## Deploy",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "### Vercel",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "On the Vercel dashboard -&gt; Storage, create a Turso SQLite database.",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sh",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run deploy-vercel",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "Link the newly created resources to your project and re-deploy.",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "You can also connect using your git repository to leverage Vercel's CI/CD pipeline.",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "### Cloudflare worker",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sh",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run deploy-cloudflare",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "Wrangler will create the necessary resources on your Cloudflare account.",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "You can also connect using your git repository to leverage Cloudflare's CI/CD pipeline.",
            "lineNumber": 49
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.16727763414382935
    },

        "contents": "import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm'\nimport { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\n\n/**\n * GET /monitors/:id/logs\n * Get logs for a specific monitor (authentication required)\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  await requireUserSession(event)\n\n  const id = getRouterParam(event, 'id')\n\n  if (!id) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing monitor ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  const serviceId = Number.parseInt(id, 10)\n\n  if (Number.isNaN(serviceId)) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Invalid service ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Check if monitor exists\n  const existingService = await db.select().from(schema.services).where(eq(schema.services.id, serviceId)).limit(1)\n\n  if (existingService.length === 0) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 404,\n      statusMessage: 'Not Found',\n      message: 'Monitor not found',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Get query parameters for pagination\n  const query = getQuery(event)\n  const limit = query.limit ? Number.parseInt(query.offset as string, 10) : 0\n\n  const logs = await getServiceLogs(serviceId, limit, offset)\n\n  return logs\n})",

        "contents": "import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm'\nimport { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\n\n/**\n * DELETE /monitors/:id\n * Delete monitor (authentication required)\n * Related logs will be deleted automatically due to cascade delete\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  await requireUserSession(event)\n\n  const id = getRouterParam(event, 'id')\n\n  if (!id) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing monitor ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  const serviceId = Number.parseInt(id, 10)\n\n  if (Number.isNaN(serviceId)) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Invalid service ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Check if monitor exists\n  const existingService = await db.select().from(schema.services).where(eq(schema.services.id, serviceId)).limit(1)\n\n  if (existingService.length === 0) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 404,\n      statusMessage: 'Not Found',\n      message: 'Service not found',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Delete service (logs will be deleted automatically due to cascade)\n  await db.delete(schema.services).where(eq(schema.services.id, serviceId))\n\n  return {\n    success: true,\n    message: 'Monitor deleted successfully',\n  }\n})",

        "contents": "import { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\n\nexport default defineEventHandler(async () =&gt; {\n  const services = await db.select().from(schema.services)\n  const overviews: ServiceOverview[] = []\n\n  const now = Temporal.Now.instant().toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n  const thirtyDaysAgo = now.subtract(Temporal.Duration.from({ days: 30 }))\n  const thirtyDaysAgoDate = new Date(thirtyDaysAgo.toInstant().epochMilliseconds)\n\n  for (const service of services) {\n    const serviceLogs = await db\n      .select()\n      .from(schema.serviceLogs)\n      .where(\n        and(\n          eq(schema.serviceLogs.serviceId, service.id),\n          gte(schema.serviceLogs.timestamp, thirtyDaysAgoDate),\n        ),\n      )\n      .orderBy(schema.serviceLogs.timestamp)\n\n    // Get the latest log for last check time\n    const latestLog = await db\n      .select()\n      .from(schema.serviceLogs)\n      .where(eq(schema.serviceLogs.serviceId, service.id))\n      .orderBy(desc(schema.serviceLogs.timestamp))\n      .limit(1)\n      .then(logs =&gt; logs[0] ?? null)\n\n    const serviceLogsByDays = manageServiceLogsByDays(serviceLogs)\n    const status = getServiceStatus(serviceLogs)\n\n    const logs: ServiceHistroy[] = Array.from(serviceLogsByDays.entries())\n      .map(([date, logsByDay]) =&gt; ({\n        date: Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from(date),\n        uptime: logsByDay.uptime,\n        latency: logsByDay.latency,\n        outages: logsByDay.outages,\n      }))\n      .sort((a, b) =&gt; a.date.epochMilliseconds - b.date.epochMilliseconds)\n\n    // Convert latest log timestamp to Temporal.ZonedDateTime\n    const lastCheckTime = latestLog\n      ? Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(\n          latestLog.timestamp instanceof Date\n            ? latestLog.timestamp.getTime()\n            : new Date(latestLog.timestamp).getTime(),\n        ).toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n      : null\n\n    overviews.push({\n      histories: logs,\n\n}",

            "line": 10

        },
        "contents": "---\nalwaysApply: true\nglobs: *.vue,*.tsx,*.ts\n---\n**Please adhere to the following rules when handling time-related data:**\n\n1. Ensure that time is maintained in **UTC** within server-side logic.\n2. When displaying time on the client side, ensure it is converted to the user's timezone using &#96;Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone&#96;.\n3. Use **&#96;Temporal&#96;** APIs instead of the &#96;Date&#96; object for time processing.\n4. Since server API responses are serialized into strings when returning JSON data, you must process time data according to the actual type returned by the server. For example, if the server returns a &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime&#96;, the client must use &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from&#96; to reconstruct the &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime&#96; object. The same applies to &#96;Temporal.PlainDateTime&#96;, &#96;Temporal.Instant&#96;, &#96;Temporal.Duration&#96;, etc.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "alwaysApply: true",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "globs: *.vue,*.tsx,*.ts",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**Please adhere to the following rules when handling time-related data:**",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Ensure that time is maintained in **UTC** within server-side logic.",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "2. When displaying time on the client side, ensure it is converted to the user's timezone using &#96;Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Use **&#96;Temporal&#96;** APIs instead of the &#96;Date&#96; object for time processing.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },

For example, if the server returns a &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime&#96;, the client must use &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from&#96; to reconstruct the &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime&#96; object. The same applies to &#96;Temporal.PlainDateTime&#96;, &#96;Temporal.Instant&#96;, &#96;Temporal.Duration&#96;, etc.",

      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {

        "contents": "---\nalwaysApply: true\n---\n# Overview\n\nThis is an uptime monitoring website built with Nuxt 4 and Nuxthub, and styling with unocss.\n\n## NPM package manager\n\nShould be pnpm, but alway install package with &#96;[ni](https://github.com/antfu-collective/ni)&#96; and related command.\n\n## How to use Nuxthub?\n\nNuxthub is a Nuxt module provider a complete backend experience on top of the framework that can deploy on many cloud providers, allowing developers to build full-stack applications.\n\n### Database\n\n- **Database Dialect**: The database dialect is set in the &#96;nuxt.config.ts&#96; file, within the &#96;hub.db&#96; option or &#96;hub.db.dialect&#96; property.\n- **Drizzle Config**: Don't generate the &#96;drizzle.config.ts&#96; file manually, it is generated automatically by NuxtHub.\n- **Generate Migrations**: Use &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to automatically generate database migrations from schema changes\n- **Never Write Manual Migrations**: Do not manually create SQL migration files in the &#96;server/db/migrations/&#96; directory\n- **Workflow**:\n  1. Create or modify the database schema in &#96;server/db/schema.ts&#96; or any other schema file in the &#96;server/db/schema/&#96; directory\n  2. Run &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to generate the migration\n  3. Run &#96;npx nuxt db migrate&#96; to apply the migration to the database, or run &#96;npx nuxt dev&#96; to apply the migration during development\n- **Access the database**: Use the &#96;db&#96; instance from &#96;hub:db&#96; to query the database, it is a Drizzle ORM instance.\n- **Access the database schema**: Use the &#96;schema&#96; from &#96;hub:db&#96; to access the schemas.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "alwaysApply: true",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "# Overview",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "This is an uptime monitoring website built with Nuxt 4 and Nuxthub, and styling with unocss.",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## NPM package manager",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "Should be pnpm, but alway install package with &#96;[ni](https://github.com/antfu-collective/ni)&#96; and related command.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "## How to use Nuxthub?",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "Nuxthub is a Nuxt module provider a complete backend experience on top of the framework that can deploy on many cloud providers, allowing developers to build full-stack applications.",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "### Database",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Database Dialect**: The database dialect is set in the &#96;nuxt.config.ts&#96; file, within the &#96;hub.db&#96; option or &#96;hub.db.dialect&#96; property.",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Drizzle Config**: Don't generate the &#96;drizzle.config.ts&#96; file manually, it is generated automatically by NuxtHub.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Generate Migrations**: Use &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to automatically generate database migrations from schema changes",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Never Write Manual Migrations**: Do not manually create SQL migration files in the &#96;server/db/migrations/&#96; directory",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Workflow**:",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. Create or modify the database schema in &#96;server/db/schema.ts&#96; or any other schema file in the &#96;server/db/schema/&#96; directory",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. Run &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to generate the migration",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. Run &#96;npx nuxt db migrate&#96; to apply the migration to the database, or run &#96;npx nuxt dev&#96; to apply the migration during development",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access the database**: Use the &#96;db&#96; instance from &#96;hub:db&#96; to query the database, it is a Drizzle ORM instance.",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access the database schema**: Use the &#96;schema&#96; from &#96;hub:db&#96; to access the schemas.",
            "lineNumber": 27
          }
        ]

        "contents": "import { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\nimport { z } from 'zod'\n\nconst createServiceSchema = z.object({\n  name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),\n  url: z.url('Invalid URL format'),\n  method: z.enum(['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']).default('GET'),\n  tags: z.array(z.string()).default([]),\n  type: z.enum(['public', 'private']).default('public'),\n})\n\n/**\n * POST /services\n * Add new service (authentication required)\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  await requireUserSession(event)\n\n  const validateBody = await readValidatedBody(event, createServiceSchema.safeParse)\n  if (!validateBody.success) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: validateBody.error.message,\n    })\n  }\n\n  const body = validateBody.data\n\n  // Validate required fields\n  if (!body.name || !body.url) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing required fields: name, url',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Insert new monitor\n  const [newService] = await db.insert(schema.services).values({\n    name: body.name,\n    url: body.url,\n    method: body.method,\n    tags: body.tags,\n    type: body.type,\n  }).returning()\n\n  return {\n    monitor: newService,\n  }\n})",

        "contents": "---\nalwaysApply: true\nglobs: *.vue,*.tsx,*.ts\n---\n**Please adhere to the following rules when handling time-related data:**\n\n1. Ensure that time is maintained in **UTC** within server-side logic.\n2. When displaying time on the client side, ensure it is converted to the user's timezone using &#96;Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone&#96;.\n3. Use **&#96;Temporal&#96;** APIs instead of the &#96;Date&#96; object for time processing.\n4. Since server API responses are serialized into strings when returning JSON data, you must process time data according to the actual type returned by the server. For example, if the server returns a &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime&#96;, the client must use &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from&#96; to reconstruct the &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime&#96; object. The same applies to &#96;Temporal.PlainDateTime&#96;, &#96;Temporal.Instant&#96;, &#96;Temporal.Duration&#96;, etc.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

            "text": "---",

          },
          {
            "text": "**Please adhere to the following rules when handling time-related data:**",

          },
          {
            "text": "1. Ensure that time is maintained in **UTC** within server-side logic.",

            "text": "2. When displaying time on the client side, ensure it is converted to the user's timezone using &#96;Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone&#96;.",

The same applies to &#96;Temporal.PlainDateTime&#96;, &#96;Temporal.Instant&#96;, &#96;Temporal.Duration&#96;, etc.",

        "contents": "&lt;script setup lang=\"ts\"&gt;\nimport type { SerializeObject } from 'nitropack'\n\nimport { Tooltip } from '@ark-ui/vue/tooltip'\n\nconst props = defineProps&lt;{\n  history: SerializeObject&lt;ServiceHistroy&gt;\n}&gt;()\n\nconst uptimeBgColor = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (props.history.uptime === null) {\n    return 'bg-gray-400'\n  }\n  if (props.history.uptime &gt;= 99.9) {\n    return 'bg-emerald-500'\n  }\n  else if (props.history.uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return 'bg-amber-400'\n  }\n  else {\n    return 'bg-rose-500'\n  }\n})\n\nconst uptimeTextColor = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (props.history.uptime === null) {\n    return 'text-gray-400'\n  }\n  if (props.history.uptime &gt;= 99.9) {\n    return 'text-emerald-500'\n  }\n  else if (props.history.uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return 'text-amber-400'\n  }\n  else {\n    return 'text-rose-500'\n  }\n})\n\nconst latencyColor = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (props.history.latency === null) {\n    return 'text-gray-400'\n  }\n  if (props.history.latency &gt; 800) {\n    return 'text-rose-500'\n  }\n  else if (props.history.latency &gt; 500) {\n    return 'text-amber-400'\n  }\n  else {\n    return 'text-emerald-500'\n  }\n})\n\nconst outages = computed&lt;string[]&gt;(() =&gt;         "relativeWorkspacePath": "./README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

            "line": 49

        "contents": "# NuxtPulse\n\nNuxtPulse is a modern uptime monitoring / status page\n\nNuxtPulse base on Nuxt.js and [@nuxthub/core](https://nuxt.com/modules/hub), learn more on [hub.nuxt.com](https://hub.nuxt.com/).\n\n## Features\n\n&gt; WIP\n\n## Development\n\n### Setup\n\nMake sure to install the dependencies with pnpm.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\npnpm install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThen start development server with &#96;dev&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\npnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deploy\n\n### Vercel\n\nOn the Vercel dashboard -&gt; Storage, create a Turso SQLite database.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\nnpm run deploy-vercel\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nLink the newly created resources to your project and re-deploy.\n\nYou can also connect using your git repository to leverage Vercel's CI/CD pipeline.\n\n### Cloudflare worker\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\nnpm run deploy-cloudflare\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWrangler will create the necessary resources on your Cloudflare account.\n\nYou can also connect using your git repository to leverage Cloudflare's CI/CD pipeline.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# NuxtPulse",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "NuxtPulse is a modern uptime monitoring / status page",
            "lineNumber": 3

          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "NuxtPulse base on Nuxt.js and [@nuxthub/core](https://nuxt.com/modules/hub), learn more on [hub.nuxt.com](https://hub.nuxt.com/).",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6

          {

            "text": "## Development",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### Setup",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "Make sure to install the dependencies with pnpm.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sh",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "pnpm install",

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "Then start development server with &#96;dev&#96;",

          },

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sh",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },

            "text": "pnpm dev",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "## Deploy",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "### Vercel",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "On the Vercel dashboard -&gt; Storage, create a Turso SQLite database.",
            "lineNumber": 31

            "lineNumber": 32

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sh",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "Link the newly created resources to your project and re-deploy.",
            "lineNumber": 37

            "lineNumber": 38

            "text": "You can also connect using your git repository to leverage Vercel's CI/CD pipeline.",

        "contents": "&lt;script setup lang=\"ts\"&gt;\nconst { data } = useQuery({\n  key: ['overview'],\n  query: () =&gt; $fetch('/api/services/overviews'),\n})\n\nconst isSystemHealthy = computed(() =&gt; data.value?.overviews.every(overview =&gt; overview.service.status === ServiceStatus.Operational))\n\nconst activeServices = computed(() =&gt; data.value?.overviews.filter(overview =&gt; overview.service.status === ServiceStatus.Operational).length)\nconst totalServices = computed(() =&gt; data.value?.overviews.length ?? 0)\n\nconst averageUptime = computed(() =&gt; {\n  const uptimes = data.value?.overviews.reduce((acc, overview) =&gt; {\n    const serviceUptime = overview.histories.reduce((acc, history) =&gt; acc + (history.uptime ?? 0), 0) ?? 0\n    return acc + serviceUptime\n  }, 0) ?? 0\n\n  return (uptimes / totalServices.value).toFixed(2)\n})\n&lt;/script&gt;\n\n&lt;template&gt;\n  &lt;div mb-12&gt;\n    &lt;div\n      relative of-hidden",

        "contents": "---\ndescription: \nglobs: *.vue,*.tsx,*.ts\nalwaysApply: false\n---\nPlease prioritize code quality and strictly adhere to the following guidelines:\n\n1. Minimize code duplication as much as possible.\n   1. Extract types used multiple times into shared Type definitions.\n   2. Encapsulate repeatedly used component code into reusable generic components.\n2. Avoid bloated components with excessive logic. You must achieve this by extracting logic into custom Vue Composables or by splitting the UI into smaller sub-components.\n3. Demonstrate proficiency with the Vue Composition API when implementing Vue components.",

        "detailedLines": [

            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Minimize code duplication as much as possible.",
            "lineNumber": 8

        "contents": "---\nalwaysApply: true\n---\n# Overview\n\nThis is an uptime monitoring website built with Nuxt 4 and Nuxthub, and styling with unocss.\n\n## NPM package manager\n\nShould be pnpm, but alway install package with &#96;[ni](https://github.com/antfu-collective/ni)&#96; and related command.\n\n## How to use Nuxthub?\n\nNuxthub is a Nuxt module provider a complete backend experience on top of the framework that can deploy on many cloud providers, allowing developers to build full-stack applications.\n\n### Database\n\n- **Database Dialect**: The database dialect is set in the &#96;nuxt.config.ts&#96; file, within the &#96;hub.db&#96; option or &#96;hub.db.dialect&#96; property.\n- **Drizzle Config**: Don't generate the &#96;drizzle.config.ts&#96; file manually, it is generated automatically by NuxtHub.\n- **Generate Migrations**: Use &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to automatically generate database migrations from schema changes\n- **Never Write Manual Migrations**: Do not manually create SQL migration files in the &#96;server/db/migrations/&#96; directory\n- **Workflow**:\n  1. Create or modify the database schema in &#96;server/db/schema.ts&#96; or any other schema file in the &#96;server/db/schema/&#96; directory\n  2. Run &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to generate the migration\n  3. Run &#96;npx nuxt db migrate&#96; to apply the migration to the database, or run &#96;npx nuxt dev&#96; to apply the migration during development\n- **Access the database**: Use the &#96;db&#96; instance from &#96;hub:db&#96; to query the database, it is a Drizzle ORM instance.\n- **Access the database schema**: Use the &#96;schema&#96; from &#96;hub:db&#96; to access the schemas.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "alwaysApply: true",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "# Overview",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "This is an uptime monitoring website built with Nuxt 4 and Nuxthub, and styling with unocss.",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## NPM package manager",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "Should be pnpm, but alway install package with &#96;[ni](https://github.com/antfu-collective/ni)&#96; and related command.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "## How to use Nuxthub?",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "Nuxthub is a Nuxt module provider a complete backend experience on top of the framework that can deploy on many cloud providers, allowing developers to build full-stack applications.",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "### Database",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Database Dialect**: The database dialect is set in the &#96;nuxt.config.ts&#96; file, within the &#96;hub.db&#96; option or &#96;hub.db.dialect&#96; property.",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Drizzle Config**: Don't generate the &#96;drizzle.config.ts&#96; file manually, it is generated automatically by NuxtHub.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Generate Migrations**: Use &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to automatically generate database migrations from schema changes",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Never Write Manual Migrations**: Do not manually create SQL migration files in the &#96;server/db/migrations/&#96; directory",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Workflow**:",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. Create or modify the database schema in &#96;server/db/schema.ts&#96; or any other schema file in the &#96;server/db/schema/&#96; directory",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. Run &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to generate the migration",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. Run &#96;npx nuxt db migrate&#96; to apply the migration to the database, or run &#96;npx nuxt dev&#96; to apply the migration during development",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access the database**: Use the &#96;db&#96; instance from &#96;hub:db&#96; to query the database, it is a Drizzle ORM instance.",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access the database schema**: Use the &#96;schema&#96; from &#96;hub:db&#96; to access the schemas.",
            "lineNumber": 27
          }
        ]

        "contents": "&lt;script setup lang=\"ts\"&gt;\nimport type { SerializeObject } from 'nitropack'\n\nconst props = defineProps&lt;{\n  overview: SerializeObject&lt;ServiceOverview&gt;\n}&gt;()\n\nfunction getStatusColor(status: ServiceStatus): string {\n  switch (status) {\n    case ServiceStatus.Operational: return 'bg-emerald-500'\n    case ServiceStatus.Degraded: return 'bg-amber-400'\n    case ServiceStatus.Down: return 'bg-rose-500'\n    case ServiceStatus.Maintenance: return 'bg-blue-400'\n    default: return 'bg-gray-400'\n  }\n}\n\nfunction getStatusText(status: ServiceStatus): string {\n  switch (status) {\n    case ServiceStatus.Operational: return '运行正常'\n    case ServiceStatus.Degraded: return '性能降低'\n    case ServiceStatus.Down: return '服务中断'\n    case ServiceStatus.Maintenance: return '维护中'\n    default: return '未知状态'\n  }\n}\n\n// Calculate 30-day uptime percentage\nconst uptimePercentage = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (!props.overview.histories || props.overview.histories.length === 0) {\n    return 0\n  }\n\n  const validHistories = props.overview.histories.filter(h =&gt; h.uptime !== null)\n  if (validHistories.length === 0) {\n    return 0\n  }\n\n  const totalUptime = validHistories.reduce((sum, h) =&gt; sum + (h.uptime ?? 0), 0)\n  return totalUptime / validHistories.length\n})\n\n// Get latest latency from most recent history\nconst latestLatency = computed(() =&gt; {\n  const histories = [...props.overview.histories].sort((a, b) =&gt;\n    Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from(b.date).epochMilliseconds - Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from(a.date).epochMilliseconds,\n  )\n  return histories.find(h =&gt; h.latency !== null)?.latency ?? null\n})\n\n// Get last check time from overview\nconst lastCheckTime = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (!props.overview.lastCheckTime) {\n    return null\n  }",

        "contents": "import { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\nimport { z } from 'zod'\n\nconst createServiceSchema = z.object({\n  name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),\n  url: z.url('Invalid URL format'),\n  method: z.enum(['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']).default('GET'),\n  tags: z.array(z.string()).default([]),\n  type: z.enum(['public', 'private']).default('public'),\n})\n\n/**\n * POST /services\n * Add new service (authentication required)\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  await requireUserSession(event)\n\n  const validateBody = await readValidatedBody(event, createServiceSchema.safeParse)\n  if (!validateBody.success) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: validateBody.error.message,\n    })\n  }\n\n  const body = validateBody.data\n\n  // Validate required fields\n  if (!body.name || !body.url) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing required fields: name, url',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Insert new monitor\n  const [newService] = await db.insert(schema.services).values({\n    name: body.name,\n    url: body.url,\n    method: body.method,\n    tags: body.tags,\n    type: body.type,\n  }).returning()\n\n  return {\n    monitor: newService,\n  }\n})",

        },
        "contents": "&lt;script setup lang=\"ts\"&gt;\nimport type { SerializeObject } from 'nitropack'\n\nimport { Tooltip } from '@ark-ui/vue/tooltip'\n\nconst props = defineProps&lt;{\n  history: SerializeObject&lt;ServiceHistroy&gt;\n}&gt;()\n\nconst uptimeBgColor = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (props.history.uptime === null) {\n    return 'bg-gray-400'\n  }\n  if (props.history.uptime &gt;= 99.9) {\n    return 'bg-emerald-500'\n  }\n  else if (props.history.uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return 'bg-amber-400'\n  }\n  else {\n    return 'bg-rose-500'\n  }\n})\n\nconst uptimeTextColor = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (props.history.uptime === null) {\n    return 'text-gray-400'\n  }\n  if (props.history.uptime &gt;= 99.9) {\n    return 'text-emerald-500'\n  }\n  else if (props.history.uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return 'text-amber-400'\n  }\n  else {\n    return 'text-rose-500'\n  }\n})\n\nconst latencyColor = computed(() =&gt; 已实现登录页面，包含：

1. **UI 组件**：
   - 带勾选标记的盾牌图标
   - 标题“管理员验证”和副标题
   - 带锁图标的密码输入框
   - 主要按钮“解锁控制台”
   - 次要链接“返回仪表盘”
   - 底部演示密码信息

2. **功能**：
   - 调用 `/api/login` 进行身份验证
   - 错误处理和显示
   - 登录成功后重定向到首页
   - 支持回车键提交
   - 加载状态显示

3. **样式**：
   - 使用 UnoCSS，支持深色模式
   - 居中卡片布局
   - 遵循项目的设计模式（zinc 配色、圆角、阴影等）
   - 使用 `layout: false` 避免显示默认的 header 和 footer

页面已实现，可直接使用。
